sentences.text:
In Re:- An application for anticipatory bail under
section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure in
 connection with Dhantala P.S. Case No.298 dated
 24.04.2023 under Sections 272/273/420 of the Indian
 Penal Code.

In the matter of : Rina Bairagi @ Bairagya  ... petitioner  Mr. Navanil De,
 Ms. Monami Mukherjee  ... for the petitioner  Mr. Saibal Bapuli, ld. APP  Mr. Soumitra Ganguli  ... for the State  1.
Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.
2. The petitioner is alleged to be running a unit for supplying mineral water without licence.
But it is fairly submitted at the Bar that the quality of the water supplied by the petitioner is found to be not contaminated.

3. Regard being had to such facts and submissions, factum of permanent residence of the petitioner,
nature of allegation and substantial progress in investigation, it is directed that the petitioner shall be released on bail by the Arresting Officer in the event of her arrest in the aforesaid P.S. case on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper in the facts and circumstances of the case.
4. Accordingly, the prayer for the anticipatory bail is allowed.
5. Within 21 days from today petitioner is directed to appear before the I.O. along with a server copy or certified copy of this order.
6. The application being CRM(A) 3026 of 2023 is disposed of.
7. The Arresting Officer is hereby directed to act upon the server copy of this order.
